entries.2세 미만의 소아는 각각의 콧구멍에 1회씩 뿌립니다.2세 이상의 소아는: For children under 2 years of age, spray once into each nostril. For children 2 years of age and older, spray 1 to 2 times into each nostril, 2 to 4 times a day or whenever needed.

Mild itching, pain, or bleeding may occur.
entries.만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1개, 1일 3회의 범위 내에서 직장내에: For adults and those 15 years of age and older, insert 1 piece into the rectum at a time, within the range of 3 times a day.
entries.부종(부기), 자극감, 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어 붉어짐, 가려움 등: If edema (swelling), a feeling of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congestion causing reddening, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.스프레이 노즐은 1~24개월 영아에게, 젯 노즐은 6세 이상 어린이 및: Use the spray nozzle for infants aged 1 to 24 months and the jet nozzle for children 6 years of age and older and for adults, spraying 2 times into each nasal cavity in the morning and in the evening. To keep the solution from running down into the larynx or pharynx, lie on your side at an angle or stand with your head tilted while using it.
entries.스프레이 노즐은 1개월 미만 영아에게 사용하지 않습니다.젯 노즐은 6세: Do not use the spray nozzle in infants under 1 month of age. Do not use the jet nozzle in infants and young children under 6 years of age. If several people share it, an infection may be spread.

Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or who may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If your symptoms do not improve after about 7 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it in children. Use this medicine only in the rectum and do not use it orally. If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has become too hard, soften it before use. entries.아침 ∙ 저녁 1회 1개씩, 1일 2회 가능한 한 배변 후 항문내에 삽입: Insert 1 piece into the anus at a time in the morning and in the evening, 2 times a day, preferably after a bowel movement.
entries.이 약 또는 벤잘코늄염화물에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or to benzalkonium chloride. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms related to nasal drops (for example, rash, redness, swelling, or a stinging sensation), or if you have recently had nose surgery or have a lesion. Use this medicine only as a nasal drop. For hygiene, one product should be used by one person only. entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약이 무르게 된 경: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. If the medicine has become soft, cool it briefly before use, and if it has hardened too much, soften it before use. Use this medicine only in the rectum (the large bowel) and do not use it orally.
entries.이 약은 치열, 치핵의 아픔, 가려움, 부종(부기), 출혈의 일시적 완화: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of the pain, itching, swelling and bleeding of anal fissure and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치열·치핵의 아픔·가려움·부종(부기)·출혈의 일시적 완화 및 소: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of the pain, itching, swelling (puffiness), and bleeding of anal fissures and hemorrhoids, and for disinfection.
This medicine is used for hemorrhoids.
This medicine is used to relieve symptoms of dryness of the nasal mucosa.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농(곪음)성으로 인한 코막힘에 비강(코안): This medicine is used for washing out the nasal cavity (inside the nose) in a blocked nose caused by nasal mucosal discharge or purulent (festering) discharge, and to relieve dryness of the nasal mucosa.
This medicine is used for nasal cavity irrigation for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucous discharge or purulent (suppurative) conditions.
entries.젯 노즐은 영유아가 사용 시 분사압력이 커서 잘못된 곳으로 들어가거나 후: The jet nozzle has a strong spray pressure, so when it is used in infants and young children there is a risk that the solution may enter the wrong place or that laryngeal spasm may occur.
entries.충혈되어 붉어짐, 부종(부기), 자극감, 알레르기 증상(발진, 충혈되어: If congestion causing reddening, edema (swelling), a feeling of irritation, allergic symptoms (rash, congestion causing reddening, itching, etc.), or bleeding occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.코에 염증이 생긴 경우 일시적으로 따끔거림 등이 나타날 수 있습니다.따끔: If the nose is inflamed, a temporary stinging sensation and similar effects may occur. If the stinging persists, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.필요시 2~3시간마다 성인은 1~8회, 영아는 1회, 1개월~12개월은: When needed, spray every 2 to 3 hours: adults 1 to 8 times, newborn infants 1 time, infants 1 to 12 months of age 1 to 2 times, children 1 to 2 years of age 1 to 3 times, children 2 to 5 years of age 1 to 4 times, children 5 to 8 years of age 1 to 5 times, and children 8 to 12 years of age 1 to 6 times. For detailed directions and dosage, refer to the detailed information in the approved labeling.
Do not take this medicine together with antihypertensive medicines or antidepressants.
